rationale.consistency: Code follows Go CLI and filesystem conventions closely, leveraging standard libraries like fs and flag appropriately.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles symlinks, overlapping sources, and name conflicts robustly, though misses printing usage on zero-argument error.
rationale.scope: Implements all required functionality precisely, with a minor miss on printing the usage text when invoked without arguments.
rationale.readability: Clean separation of concerns with clear naming, logical package layout, and tabular output for list.
rationale.robustness: Uses non-blocking directory locks properly and removes metadata sidecars first to avoid index corruption.
rationale.maintainability: Decoupled repository discovery, planning, and execution makes the tool highly extensible and easy to test.
